summary: The customer is seeking an optical spectroscopy approach to monitor growth and detect changes early during yeast fermentation, specifically asking how to structure a feasibility study with appropriate reference measurements given undefined biomass and metabolic targets.

facts_stated.text: The team has discussed obtaining both a biomass signal and a metabolic signal.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our team has mentioned both a biomass signal and a metabolic signal

facts_stated.text: Biomass and metabolic signals have not yet been defined as separate measurement targets.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: these have not been defined as separate targets

facts_stated.text: Optical density of the fermentation broth increases as the process progresses.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops

targets.purpose: to help us follow growth and notice changes earlier

optical_regime.enquiry_quote: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops

process.value: Broth becomes increasingly optically dense during the run
